case: FruitBlend24 Revenue Management / Data Analyst Intern Assessment
decisions: Which products, kitchens, prices and promotions should management change to increase contribution?
Which portfolio items need action after separating variable contribution from allocated overhead?
How should daily cup demand and recorded waste inform a three-month prep/replenishment plan?
Can the historical and projected P&L be reconciled to the source workbook and monthly budget?
required_outputs: Data quality issue log, source inventory, and released clean data version
Demand, pricing, promotion, portfolio, budget, and historical P&L evidence tables
Three-month cup-based forecast, backtest, waste scenarios, and projected P&L
Memo/presentation with 3-5 insights and at least 3 recommendations covering pricing, portfolio, and inventory
Reproducible code and a short tools/approach note
acceptance_criteria: Every headline metric traces to the released data version and metric contract
Raw row, unit, and revenue bridges reconcile within documented tolerance
Observed values are separated from proxy estimates and unresolved values are not silently zeroed
Forecast validation uses only data available before each backtest cutoff
Recommendations name action, owner, timing, KPI, evidence, and key limitation
Presentation numbers are linked to analysis artifacts rather than recalculated independently
dependency_order: A6 data QA -> A3 and A4 in parallel
A6 -> A7 memo and presentation -> A6/A0 final review
